Speaker: Kael
Text: You know, Lira used to help me in the workshop. She'd hand me tools before I even asked for them. Like she could read my mind.

Speaker: Kael
Text: I keep thinking... if I'd just held on tighter when the Rift hit. But you can't hold onto someone when reality itself is tearing apart.

Speaker: Kael
Text: Maren — my wife — she always said I was too stubborn for my own good. That I'd fix a broken pipe until my hands bled rather than call for help.

Speaker: Kael
Text: She was right. But this time, stubbornness might be the only thing that brings Lira home.

Speaker: Kael
Text: I found one of Lira's drawings in my pack yesterday. A picture of our family — me, Maren, her, and Cinder. She drew steam coming out of everyone's ears.

Speaker: Kael
Text: I laughed. First time in a long while. Thank you for being here. I mean that.

Speaker: Kael
Text: The seer said Lira might have changed. That the Ethereal Realm changes people. I've been trying not to think about what that means.

Speaker: Kael
Text: But even if she's different... she's still my daughter. That doesn't change. It can't.

Speaker: Kael
Text: When this is over — when Lira is safe — I want to rebuild the workshop. A real one, not just for steam engines. For whatever comes next.

Speaker: Kael
Text: And I want you all there. Every one of you. You're family now. The kind you choose.
